title: German Broad Bean Bake
description: A delicious and simple German-inspired dish made with broad beans, perfect for a comforting meal. This recipe is easy to follow and requires minimal ingredients.
instructions: Trim the ends of the broad beans and cut them into 1-inch pieces.
In a large pan, sauté the chopped onion and minced garlic in butter until softened.
Add the broad beans to the pan and cook for 2-3 minutes.
In a separate bowl, mix the flour and grated Gruyère cheese.
Add the flour and cheese mixture to the pan with the broad beans and stir until well combined.
Transfer the mixture to a baking dish and top with additional grated cheese if desired.
Bake for 20-25 minutes or until the top is golden brown and the filling is heated through.
